=== Possibly faulty data ===
* 2005 Minnesota State Championship: [[Nick Kolnik]] (TD) called Herold the defending Minnesota State Champion in May 2006, and his signature claims the title, but the PC's 2005 Worlds qualifier listing gives the Minnesota Day 2 bye to [[Alden Peterson]] (the bye may have passed down; not stated).
